greeting: Greetings, artificer! Read the jam rules here, visit the pantry for inspiration, then the cauldron to submit.
quips: A small, imperfect game is a powerful spell. Try something new!
Ingredients are inspiration— you don't need to empty the whole pantry.
Save your status link. Even wizards misplace their receipts.
Submit early, submit often. Give the fates some time, and yourself room to breathe.
Remember your licenses and credits. A borrowed spell still has an author.
My finest potion? A full night's sleep before debugging.
Don't worry, you're in good company. We're all lunatics here!
One wizard's failed brew is another wizard's lunch... or something. You can submit a valiant effort and try anew!
Stop obsessing over perfect ingredients, it's the effect that matters.
Beware the scope demons who creep! You can always expand your game after the jam.
I'd rather drink an ugly sweet potion than a bitter pretty one. Looks aren't everything!
Don't waste the work of other wizards— we publish recipes and ingredients for a reason!
What's more powerful than a wizard? Two wizards, obviously.
Stuck? I hear ducks are all the rage... any familiar will do, though.
